portal.title: Find your Mishran
portal.intro: Each vertical carries the same milk‑first promise, dressed for the moment — a quiet Tuesday, a wedding mehendi, a corporate launch, or a hamper that travels across India.

mithai.label: Mithai
mithai.description: The canon — kaju katli, motichoor, besan laddoo — finished fresh, in weights that suit a Tuesday or a thousand‑box wedding.

qsr.label: QSR
qsr.description: Counter‑quick mithai and savouries from our high‑street kitchens. Walk in, take a box, carry on with your day.

snacks.label: Snacks
snacks.description: Namkeen, mathri, chivra — the savoury shelf of the Mishran house, built for evening chai and travel tins.

merch.label: Merch
merch.description: Hamper shells, thalis, and keepsake boxes — the vessels that carry Mishran into homes and across occasions.

pillars.title: Four promises, kept daily.
pillars.intro: The Mishran house is built on four non‑negotiables — they shape every batch, every box, every karigar's day.

milkPurity.label: Milk Purity
milkPurity.description: Milk from our Jhajjar farm, boiled fresh each morning — no milk powder, no reconstituted cream, ever.

karigarMastery.label: Karigar Mastery
karigarMastery.description: Each sweet is finished by a karigar whose family has held the recipe for generations — hands that know when chashni is ready by sound.

karigari.label: Karigari
karigari.description: The craft itself — the vark on a katli, the boondi of a laddoo, the fold of a peda — done the long way, never the shortcut way.

modernExperience.label: Modern Experience
modernExperience.description: Boutique packaging, honest labels, on‑time delivery — the same mithai, dressed for how India celebrates today.
